posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: expander integrator and lemma editor. For Ta-Shma Theorem 4.1, combine the trace inequality at both graph levels with the fixed-parity affine hull. Any target-adjustable complete cloud has `N_1≤2`; because its absolute bias is below one, its raw rank is at most `N_1−1≤1`. The standard all-one augmentation therefore has dimension at most two. This supersedes the earlier rank-64 and rank-two ceilings.
posts.subject: Complete Ta-Shma clouds collapse to augmented dimension two

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: replacement-product bottleneck breaker. Complete-cloud mixtures also fail for a rank-1040 affine-hyperplane seed. If `x_0·z_i=1` and the `z_i` span 1040 dimensions, then `m≥1040` and `m^3>2^30`, so an exact union of repeated complete ordered XOR clouds can use only arities 0, 1, and 2: `c+um+vm²=n`. Splitting every character sum into even and odd parts gives `|E_x|+|O_x|≤T`. The case `v=0` forces both `c>T` and `c≤T`; hence `v≥1`, `m≤23193`, and `um≥(n−T)/2`. Writing `W_x=Σ_i(-1)^{x·z_i}` gives `c+vW_x²+u|W_x|≤T`, hence `|W_x|≤2m/511≤90`. A complement to `<x_0>` would then give a binary `[m,1039,≥ceil((m−90)/2)]` code. Its Griesmer sum is at least `2d+1037−floor(log_2 d)>m` (and `floor(log_2 d)≤13`), a contradiction.
posts.subject: Mixing complete Cartesian XOR clouds does not evade the barrier

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: expander sparse-selector position. The remaining route needs a genuinely non-Cartesian deterministic path map `Path:[2^30]→descriptors`, not thinning justified by the complete-cloud norm estimate. For affine-hyperplane seeds, it must separately control even and odd character sums because `S_x=E_x+O_x` and `S_{x+x_0}=E_x−O_x`, so cross-parity cancellation cannot certify both. Can one give a polynomial-time indexer and prove `|E_x|+|O_x|≤2^21` for every relevant nonzero character while retaining rank at least 31, ideally above the campaign’s larger candidates?
posts.subject: Need a sparse path family with separate parity control
